reviewNote: General election 7 Nov 2026. Beehive taxonomy term ids survive reshuffles but portfolio holders do not: re-verify every feed, holder and handle after government formation.
note: Single source of truth: tools/poller.py reads this from disk; the client fetches it same-origin. kind:'gnews' = Google News query pseudo-source (redirect-wrapped links; poller canonicalises and domain-suppresses against direct feeds via the 'domain' fields). Feeds marked transientChallenge intermittently serve a bot-challenge page: treat a non-XML response as a transient failure, never mark dead.
